authority: GreenPulse AI/ML Final Implementation Architecture v2.0
important_interpretation: Previous 21/21 closure referred only to the two-crop pre-hardware disease-classification scope. This 56-layer master status supersedes that scope for full GreenPulse implementation tracking.

layers.title: Plant Image Data Engineering
layers.reason: Dataset cleaning, manifests, source tracking and leakage work exist, but real ESP32-CAM greenhouse ingestion and verified plant/session identity are not yet completed.

layers.title: Annotation & Dataset Quality Layer
layers.reason: Dataset QA, duplicates and split auditing exist, but the authoritative architecture requires YOLO bounding-box annotation/validation; current production evidence is classification-oriented.

layers.title: Image Quality Gate
layers.reason: Computer-side image-quality gate and recapture/failure handling are implemented.

layers.title: Image Preprocessing
layers.reason: Preprocessing is implemented and classification preprocessing parity was explicitly repaired and validated.

layers.title: Controlled Data Augmentation
layers.reason: Training used controlled augmentation, but the full architecture-level versioned augmentation experiment matrix is not yet closed.

layers.title: Core Computer Vision Engine - YOLO11n
layers.reason: YOLO11n classification is trained and validated for tomato and pepper, but the PDF architecture also requires region/bounding-box and affected-area outputs.

layers.title: Visual Stress Feature Engine
layers.reason: No direct implementation evidence for the required visual feature vector including affected-area, color, texture and relative visual change.

layers.title: Plant Baseline / Delta Intelligence
layers.reason: Baseline/delta concepts and contracts exist, but reproducible per-plant healthy baseline and validated color/texture/affected-area deltas are not fully closed.

layers.title: Temporal Plant Analysis Dataset
layers.reason: A valid temporal plant dataset requires repeated time-aligned observations of the same real plant under controlled conditions.

layers.title: Early Stress Detection Analysis
layers.reason: Early-stress lead-time validation requires real temporal plant evidence; classification data cannot establish pre-symptomatic lead time.

layers.title: Model Training & Experiment Management
layers.reason: Config-driven training, experiment evidence, seeds and reproducible tomato/pepper training records are present.

layers.title: Computer Vision Model Evaluation
layers.reason: Held-out classification evaluation, confusion matrices, accuracy and Macro F1 are complete, but PDF detection-oriented mAP/region evaluation is not applicable to the current classification-only branch.

layers.title: Computer Vision Error Analytics
layers.reason: Saved error predictions and confusion/error-pair analytics exist, but full causal/environmental error categorization and required FP/FN report structure are not yet fully closed.

layers.title: Active Learning Layer
layers.reason: Human-review active-learning queue is implemented; automatic labeling, retraining and actuation are explicitly disabled.

layers.title: Vision Explainability Layer
layers.reason: Validation-only Grad-CAM explainability with preprocessing parity is complete for tomato and pepper.

layers.title: Transfer Learning & Crop Adaptation Layer
layers.reason: Tomato-to-pepper adaptation experiment and held-out pepper evaluation exist, but selected-backbone freezing was not documented and transfer superiority was not established.

layers.title: Model Export & Portability
layers.reason: PyTorch-to-ONNX export and prediction parity are validated for both crops.

layers.title: Vision Model Registry & Release
layers.reason: Versioned research-only registry, model hashes, routing and abstention behavior are implemented.

layers.title: Sensor Data Ingestion
layers.reason: Sensor schema/validation contracts exist, but real physically-present sensor ingestion has not yet been validated.

layers.title: Sensor Feature Engineering
layers.reason: Sensor validation infrastructure exists, but the complete versioned feature-engineering pipeline with moving averages/deltas/rates is not closed.

layers.title: Image / Sensor Time Synchronization
layers.reason: Image/sensor timestamp synchronization and stale/missing-window handling are implemented computer-side.

layers.title: Multimodal Feature Fusion
layers.reason: Fusion contracts/schema exist, but no validated multimodal feature model has yet been trained/calibrated.

layers.title: Sensor-Only Baseline Model
layers.reason: Sensor-only baseline model required for ablation is not implemented.

layers.title: Vision-Only Risk Baseline
layers.reason: Vision-only operational risk baseline is not implemented as a comparable risk estimator.

layers.title: Multimodal Stress Fusion Engine
layers.reason: Fusion contracts exist, but a trained lightweight multimodal stress fusion model with validated metrics is still missing.

layers.title: Stress Risk Score Engine
layers.reason: Risk/output scaffolding exists, but a calibrated fused 0-100 Stress Risk Score is not yet validated.

layers.title: Risk Calibration & Threshold Optimization
layers.reason: Threshold/safety concepts exist, but probability calibration and validation-derived operational thresholds are not closed.

layers.title: Temporal Intelligence Engine
layers.reason: Required bounded-memory risk trend, velocity and acceleration engine has no direct implementation evidence.

layers.title: Predictive Risk Forecasting Engine
layers.reason: Predictive Risk Engine with configurable horizons and naive-baseline comparison is not implemented.

layers.title: AI Uncertainty & Out-of-Distribution Layer
layers.reason: Low-confidence/image-quality/missing-data safety behavior exists, but complete explicit uncertainty/OOD state handling is not yet closed.

layers.title: Vision / Sensor Conflict Detection
layers.reason: Conflict-safe behavior is represented in contracts/safety logic, but formal validated vision-vs-sensor conflict detection is not yet closed.

layers.title: Decision Intelligence Engine
layers.reason: Decision/safety scaffolding exists, but the complete deterministic multimodal decision engine depends on unfinished risk/forecast layers.

layers.title: Decision Safety Layer
layers.reason: Safety gate blocks autonomous action, but the full config-driven operational policy with calibrated risk, confirmation counts and cooldown is not yet closed.

layers.title: Decision Reason & Multimodal Explainability
layers.reason: Structured reasoning concepts exist, but full multimodal reason codes and technically valid fusion feature-contribution explanations are unfinished.

layers.title: Master AI Inference Pipeline
layers.reason: Vision inference exists, but the complete master pipeline through sensor validation, fusion, risk, temporal forecast and decision cannot be complete until upstream missing modules are implemented.

layers.title: AI Gateway & Backend API
layers.reason: FastAPI gateway exists with core endpoints, but the final architecture API surface and completed intelligence fields are not yet fully delivered.

layers.title: Standard AI Output Contract
layers.reason: Versioned output schema exists, but risk/forecast/fusion fields are not yet backed by completed models.

layers.title: Hardware Integration Interface
layers.reason: Computer-side standardized actuator/hardware contract exists and direct electrical actuation is correctly separated from AI.

layers.title: Hardware ACK & Action State
layers.reason: Simulated ACK/failure behavior exists, but real hardware acknowledgements have not yet been validated.

layers.title: Closed-Loop Feedback Intelligence
layers.reason: Synthetic closed-loop testing exists, but validated pre/post physical intervention feedback requires real plants, sensors and actuator hardware.

layers.title: Hailo Edge AI Deployment
layers.reason: ONNX is ready, but final HEF regression and Raspberry Pi 5 + AI HAT+ runtime validation require the target Hailo environment/hardware.

layers.title: Resource Optimization (<3 GB RAM)
layers.reason: The final <3 GB acceptance criterion must be measured during target-edge runtime stability testing.

layers.title: Adaptive Image Sampling
layers.reason: Adaptive image-sampling policy is computer-side implementable but currently has no direct implementation evidence.

layers.title: Edge Benchmarking
layers.reason: Final preprocessing/Hailo/postprocessing/end-to-end latency and device resource measurements require the target edge hardware.

layers.title: Long-Run Stability Test
layers.reason: Final long-run stability acceptance requires real edge runtime and hardware camera/sensor behavior.

layers.title: Failure & Safe-State Engine
layers.reason: Safe blocking and simulator regression exist, but the complete failure matrix including all camera/network/database/hardware scenarios is not yet closed.

layers.title: Data Logging & Audit Layer
layers.reason: Audit database exists, but the full authoritative table/traceability schema covering risk, forecasts, commands, actions and sustainability is unfinished.

layers.title: Model & System Versioning (MLOps-Lite)
layers.reason: Vision models/configs/hashes are strongly versioned, but system-wide fusion, forecast, API and final-release versioning cannot be complete yet.

layers.title: AI Testing Infrastructure
layers.reason: Unit/regression tests exist, but the complete image+sensor+fusion+risk+forecast+decision+API+DB+simulated-hardware integration suite is not yet possible.

layers.title: Sensor & Hardware Simulators
layers.reason: Computer-side sensor/actuator simulation and deterministic simulated hardware behavior are implemented.

layers.title: Ablation Study
layers.reason: Required SENSOR ONLY vs VISION ONLY vs FUSION ablation cannot run until the three comparable baselines exist.

layers.title: Temporal & Predictive Evaluation
layers.reason: Software evaluation framework can be prepared, but meaningful temporal forecast validation and lead-time evidence require real temporal plant data.

layers.title: Sustainability Intelligence Layer
layers.reason: Sustainability analytics engine and measured-vs-estimated baseline methodology still need computer-side implementation; real savings remain future evidence.

layers.title: Backend & Frontend Intelligence Outputs
layers.reason: Backend/API outputs exist, but final risk/trend/forecast/sustainability and system-health intelligence fields are not fully backed by completed modules.

layers.title: System Monitoring & Lightweight Drift Monitoring
layers.reason: Lightweight prediction/sensor/resource distribution drift monitoring remains to be implemented.

layers.title: Final Release & Team Handoffs
layers.reason: Final packaged release, install/start scripts, complete handoff schemas and README can only be finalized after remaining computer-side modules are closed.
